title: Smaller cylindrical protrusion (2 parts)
spec: Create a new coordinate system for the first cylindrical base with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of (0.0, 0.0, 0.0178). Draw a single face and within this face, draw a single loop containing a circle centered at (0.0214, 0.0214) with a radius of 0.0214. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0427 to the sketch. Rotate the scaled sketch using the Euler angles (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) and translate it using the vector (0.0, 0.0, 0.0178). Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.463 units without extruding in the opposite direction to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical base are length 0.042735042735042736, width 0.042735042735042736, and height 0.462962962962963. For the second smaller cylindrical protrusion, create another new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of (0.0071, 0.0071, 0.0178). Draw a single face and within this face, draw a single loop containing a circle centered at (0.0142, 0.0142) with a radius of 0.0142. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0285 to the sketch. Rotate the scaled sketch using the Euler angles (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) and translate it using the vector (0.0071, 0.0071, 0.0178). Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.7322 units without extruding in the opposite direction to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the smaller cylindrical protrusion are length 0.028490028490028494, width 0.028490028490028494, and height 0.7321937321937323.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the first part (Pen)
pen = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0214, 0.0214)
    .circle(0.0214)
    .extrude(0.463)
    .translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.0178))
)

# Create the second part (Cylinder)
cylinder = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0142, 0.0142)
    .circle(0.0142)
    .extrude(0.7322)
    .translate((0.0071, 0.0071, 0.0178))
)

# Combine the parts
r = pen.union(cylinder)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Larger outer tube (lower section), hollow
tube_outer_d = 0.0428
tube_inner_d = 0.0240
tube_len = 0.4623

tube = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(tube_outer_d / 2.0)
    .circle(tube_inner_d / 2.0)
    .extrude(tube_len)
)

# Smaller rod (upper section), extends out of the top of the tube
rod_d = 0.0180
rod_len = 0.7322 - tube_len + 0.15  # extends into the tube for fit

rod = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0, 0, tube_len - 0.15))
    .circle(rod_d / 2.0)
    .extrude(rod_len)
)

# Combine into a single part
r = tube.union(rod)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall bounding-box dimensions
D = 0.0428          # large diameter (X/Y bbox)
Z = 0.7322          # total height

# Stepped shaft proportions from the views
d = 0.0250          # upper/smaller diameter
L1 = 0.5000         # lower/large cylinder length
L2 = Z - L1         # upper/small cylinder length

lower = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(D / 2.0).extrude(L1)
upper = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=L1).circle(d / 2.0).extrude(L2)

r = lower.union(upper)
